title: A Busy Lesson
setting: A bright classroom with desks, a big world map and a board.

characters.name: Nina
characters.look: Nina, a girl with long black hair and a blue sweater

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: Omar, a boy with short brown hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Mister Jack
characters.look: Mister Jack, a tall man with glasses and a green tie

sentences.en: Nina and Omar sit in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 尼娜和奥马尔坐在教室里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a girl with long black hair and a blue sweater and Omar, a boy with short brown hair and a yellow shirt sit at their desks in a bright classroom.

sentences.en: Mister Jack teaches them the alphabet first.
sentences.zh: 杰克先生先教他们字母表。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mister Jack, a tall man with glasses and a green tie stands at the board pointing at a long row of letters in front of Nina, a girl with long black hair and a blue sweater and Omar, a boy with short brown hair and a yellow shirt.

sentences.en: The children repeat each letter after him.
sentences.zh: 孩子们跟着他重复每个字母。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a girl with long black hair and a blue sweater and Omar, a boy with short brown hair and a yellow shirt speak together with open mouths while Mister Jack, a tall man with glasses and a green tie points at the board.

sentences.en: Then he reads a sentence as an example.
sentences.zh: 然后他读了一个句子作为例子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mister Jack, a tall man with glasses and a green tie reads aloud from an open book in front of the class.

sentences.en: Next is a geography lesson about rivers.
sentences.zh: 接下来是一节关于河流的地理课。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mister Jack, a tall man with glasses and a green tie points at blue rivers on a big world map on the classroom wall.

sentences.en: Omar knows the names of many rivers.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔知道很多河流的名字。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a boy with short brown hair and a yellow shirt raises his hand eagerly in front of the big world map.

sentences.en: Nina writes a note with her pencil.
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a girl with long black hair and a blue sweater writes in her notebook with a yellow pencil.

sentences.en: “For homework, test yourself,” says Mister Jack.
sentences.zh: “回家作业是自己测验一下，”杰克先生说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mister Jack, a tall man with glasses and a green tie smiles and speaks to Nina, a girl with long black hair and a blue sweater and Omar, a boy with short brown hair and a yellow shirt as they pack their bags.
